title: Power and factor bounds
statement: Let $C,e,n,b,r$ be natural numbers and let $o$ be a Boolean parameter. If $b\le n+1$ and $r\le e+1$, then $b^r\le 8(2C+3)(n+1)^{e+1}$ and $F b^r\le 8(2C+3)(n+1)^{e+1}$, where $F=2C+3$ if $o$ is true and $F=C$ otherwise.
